conclusion: Thirty-three refutation attempts were run against the subject and all thirty-three were refuted against live bytes. The strongest available attack was the OBL-G23-HARNESS-SPEC closure-attribution vector: v1 of this identifier carried whatThisCloses.leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded == ['OBL-G23-HARNESS-SPEC'], which in a successor occupancy would have claimed that leftover-design closes because this file is accepted and recorded. v2 empties that field and re-attributes the closure to g23 leftover-join.v4 (D-198), the measurement that actually made it false. The second-strongest was naming-v6 provenance, since naming v6 mentions NT-3 and NT-5 six times each; reading those sites shows every one is an exclusion, and the file states verbatim 'Does not name NT-3 or NT-5 at any gate', so the subject's assignment of parentage to D-147 rather than naming v6 is correct. The live G23 harness cell is quoted byte-exact, required-now is 28, the INPUT basis is g23-input-corpus.v1, leftoverDesign remains ['OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING'], basedOn.d222.role is last-heading custody only and disclaims G19 occupancy, and every one of the 43 digest citations recomputes. No blocker and no SHOULD-FIX survives.
